description: Description: C.1's v2 simulation timed before and after the speed-up, alternating old and new code in one session (2026-10-31), High Power energy mode, on an Apple M5 Max. One simulation is one call of cma_recovery_v2.simulate_v2 on one core at the box centre (base 99,600,000); the bench is 32 such simulations (base 99,500,000) on 16 workers. Every bench record was identical between old and new code.
